changelog:
**Major update: HIP-4 market and API-key requirements, new tools, access tiers.**

- Added full support for HIP-4 outcome contracts and prediction markets, including question discovery, settlement data, and outcome/perp context tools.
- Expanded from 43 to 55 API-key-authenticated analytics tools, covering all features (no more free tools without API key).
- All features now require a Coinversa API key; setup documentation updated to reflect this change.
- Introduced detailed API access tiers (Free/Starter/Pro/Enterprise) with new rate limits and request caps.
- Updated tool documentation for builder dex and HIP-4 discovery, rate-limited headers, and remote/local MCP options.
summary: Read-only crypto intelligence for AI agents. 55 API-key-authenticated tools for Hyperliquid trader analytics, behavioral cohorts, HIP-4 outcome contracts, ou...
